name: Torch
description: A wooden handle wrapped in oil-soaked cloth. Burns for 60 game-minutes once lit, providing a warm flickering light. Use LIT TORCH to ignite it.

name: Hooded Lantern
description: A sturdy iron lantern with a glass hood that shields the flame from wind. Requires Oil Flask to fuel — burns for 90 game-minutes per fill. Use LIT LANTERN to light it (consumes one Oil Flask).

name: Oil Flask
description: A small clay flask stoppered with wax, filled with lamp oil. Used to fuel a Hooded Lantern. One flask provides 90 game-minutes of lantern light.

name: Lockpick
description: A slender steel pick used to manipulate lock tumblers. Stackable.

name: Thieves' Tools
description: A compact leather case containing picks, tension wrenches, and a small hook. Reusable with higher success chance than a plain lockpick.

name: Small Backpack
description: A simple leather pack worn across the back. Adds 8 carry slots and 30 units of weight capacity.

name: Large Backpack
description: A sturdy canvas pack with multiple compartments. Adds 12 carry slots and 50 units of weight capacity.

name: Traveller's Cart
description: A sturdy wooden cart that follows the party outdoors. Cannot enter buildings or underground areas. Adds 40 slots and 200 units of weight capacity.

name: Horse
description: A sturdy riding horse. Reduces travel stamina drain and stays outside buildings and caves.
